MINUTES

  ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL MEETING

  SEPTEMBER 18, 2017

An adjourned meeting of the City Council of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order at
4:00 p.m. in the City Council Chambers, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, by MAYOR
ZERUNYAN.

City Council Members Present:  Mitchell*, Schmitz, Zuckerman and
  Mayor Zerunyan
  *Council Member Mitchell arrived at 5:25 p.m.

City Council Members Absent:  Huff

City Staff Present:  City Manager Doug Prichard
  Assistant City Manager Greg Grammer
  Assistant to the City Manager Alexa Davis
  Senior Planner Jeannie Naughton

DISCUSSION ITEM: CALIFORNIA WATER COMPANY PIPELINE PROJECT

The City Council heard a presentation from California Water Company representatives
on the status of plans for a major pipeline replacement project that would require work
in the Palos Verdes Drive North right of way during the summer months of 2018.

A variety of options were explored including consideration of different alignment and
schedule possibilities. Difficulties with the various options between Dapplegray Lane
and Dapplegray School were discussed.

Alignment within the off-road multi-use path was considered and ultimately rejected due
to the need to remove dozens of healthy mature Pepper Trees along the City’s scenic
corridor. Council concurred that preservation of the trees was of primary importance.

Alignment within the eastbound (southern-most) lane of Palos Verdes Drive North was
agreed upon as the preferred alignment. Extensive discussion then ensued regarding the
scheduling challenges of this alignment in light of the heavy traffic volumes on the road.
Alternatives included complete road closure in one direction, maintenance of two-way
traffic with flagging, maintenance of two-way traffic at all times, night work, weekend
work, double shifts, etc.

The consensus of the Council was to seek to minimize overall construction time and
minimize total traffic disruption, while recognizing that these goals may be mutually
exclusive. California Water Company representatives indicated that they would revisit
options with this alignment and the goals in mind and report back.

 ADJOURNMENT

for the purpose of conducting interviews with applicants to the Planning Commission
and General Plan Advisory Committee.
